items.rationale: Profit is 800 - 600 = 200. Margin divides the profit by the price: 200 / 800 = 0.25, which is 25%.
Mark-up divides the profit by the cost: 200 / 600 = 0.3333, which is 33.3% to 1 decimal place.
The mark-up is 50% of the cost, so the profit is 400 x 50% = 200 and the price is 400 + 200 = 600. This is the same as 400 x (1 + 50%).

Both use the same profit on top, but margin divides by the price and mark-up divides by the cost. Price = cost + profit, so the price is the bigger number and gives the smaller percentage. Tax plays no part.
